goal_intent: book for three including a coeliac guest and ask what they can eat

turns.utterance: Good morning, thank you so much for taking my call. I wanted to see if I could book a table for this coming Sunday, please.
Thank you very much. There will be three of us for lunch. That’s three people this Sunday.
Thank you for asking. We’d like to come at 12:30pm, if you have a table available then. That’s half past twelve for three people on Sunday.
Thank you, that’s wonderful. My name is Edward Naylor—Edward with a “w,” and Naylor, N-A-Y-L-O-R. I do appreciate you taking this booking.

Thank you so much for confirming all those details. There is just one thing—my daughter is coeliac, so she can’t have any gluten. Could you please let me know what your gluten-free options are, or if there’s a separate menu for her? I just want to make sure she’ll be able to eat safely.

Thank you, that’s very reassuring to hear. Yes, please—if you could add a note to our booking that my daughter is coeliac and requires a gluten-free meal, I’d be most grateful. That way the kitchen will be aware and can take the necessary precautions. Thank you once again for your help today. 

[END OF CALL]
